findings.description: inbound_by_sku only skips CANCELLED orders. The OrderBook holds every PO ever raised, so received/closed orders are also counted as inbound. Their units are already in on_hand, so they are counted twice. Over time the available position is inflated, SKUs stop hitting the reorder point, and reorder quantities shrink or drop to zero, leading to stock-outs.
findings.suggestion: Count only orders that are still outstanding (for example DRAFT/SENT/CONFIRMED), and exclude RECEIVED as well as CANCELLED. An explicit allow-list of open statuses is safer than a deny-list.
findings.title: Inbound count includes already-received purchase orders
